name: 49094 · Union City, MI
findings: ZIP 49094 (Union City) has 8 nonprofit organizations. 3 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 3 organizations.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
